caption_en: Heading-error distributions and output availability for three raw dual-antenna processing methods during nominal walking, large body motion and single-antenna obstruction. The upper row shows cumulative distributions of absolute directional error at each method’s recorded valid outputs; the lower row marks their output times. C-LAMBDA and C-WLS denote independent implementations of the constrained objectives, with no integer acceptance test on these candidates. DD-KF uses the saved double-difference filter output. No held heading is added. The plotted direction is derived from the horizontal projection of the lateral baseline and compared with the reference yaw.
caption_zh: 三种原始双天线观测处理方法在常规行走、大幅机身运动与单侧天线遮挡下的航向误差分布和可用输出。上排为各方法已记录有效输出时刻的绝对方向误差累积分布，下排标出对应输出时间。C-LAMBDA和C-WLS为对应约束目标的独立实现，这些方向候选未设整数接受检验；DD-KF使用保存的双差滤波输出，不插入保持航向。所画方向由横向基线的水平投影换算，并与参考航向比较。
meaning_zh: 完整使用九组保存结果，把方向误差分布与输出覆盖分开呈现，避免密集正负180度跳转线遮住三种方法的差别。
